top_stories.title: OpenAI's big Codex update is a direct shot at Claude Code [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has released a major update to Codex, its AI coding agent, positioning it as a direct competitor to Anthropic's Claude Code. The update expands Codex's capabilities and is detailed in OpenAI's official announcement. The move signals intensifying competition in the agentic AI coding space.

top_stories.title: Codex for (almost) everything
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's official blog post details the expanded ambitions of Codex, framing it as a tool capable of handling a broad range of tasks beyond just coding. The announcement outlines new features and use cases for the Codex agent. This is the primary source accompanying the competitive Codex launch.

top_stories.title: Anthropic releases a new Opus model amid Mythos Preview buzz [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: Anthropic has released a new Claude Opus model, coinciding with wider speculation around a 'Mythos Preview' capability. The release keeps Anthropic competitive as rivals including OpenAI push updates to their own flagship models. The Verge reports on the timing and context of the release.

top_stories.title: The UK Launches Its $675 Million Sovereign AI Fund
top_stories.summary: The UK government has announced a $675 million sovereign AI investment fund, aimed at building domestic AI capabilities. Wired reports the fund is part of a broader push by the UK to position itself as a leading AI nation. The announcement reflects growing government interest in state-backed AI infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Gemini can now pull from Google Photos to generate personalized images [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant can now access users' Google Photos libraries to create personalized image generations. The feature, available via Gemini Nano, represents a step forward in personal AI context and on-device intelligence. The update deepens integration between Google's AI products and its existing consumer services.

further_links.title: The Battle for OpenAI's Soul
further_links.summary: Wired examines the ongoing legal and philosophical conflict between Elon Musk and Sam Altman over the direction and control of OpenAI, as the Musk v. Altman trial approaches.

further_links.title: Google's AI Mode Update Tries to Kill Tab Hopping in Chrome
further_links.summary: Google's AI Mode update now lets users open source links in an inline panel without leaving the search page, reducing the need to switch browser tabs.

further_links.title: Treating enterprise AI as an operating layer
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review explores how businesses are beginning to treat AI not as a standalone tool but as a foundational operating layer embedded across their entire technology stack.

further_links.title: Shares in shoe brand Allbirds rise 580% after it pivots from footwear to AI
further_links.summary: Allbirds, the sustainable shoe company, saw its shares surge 580% after announcing a pivot away from footwear towards AI, in a dramatic strategic reversal reported by the BBC.

further_links.title: George Orwell Predicted the Rise of "AI Slop" in Nineteen Eighty-Four
further_links.summary: Open Culture draws parallels between Orwell's fictional 'proletarian literature' machine in Nineteen Eighty-Four and the modern phenomenon of low-quality AI-generated content flooding the internet.

further_links.title: This Beanie Is Designed to Read Your Thoughts
further_links.summary: Wired reports on a consumer-oriented brain-computer interface device embedded in a beanie hat, designed to detect and interpret neural signals for everyday use.

further_links.title: AI cybersecurity is not proof of work
further_links.summary: Antirez argues that deploying AI in cybersecurity contexts does not inherently guarantee security or meaningful defence, cautioning against over-reliance on AI tools in this space.

further_links.title: We gave an AI a 3 year retail lease and asked it to make a profit
further_links.summary: Andon Labs describes an experiment in which an AI agent was given a real retail lease and tasked with running a profitable business, detailing the outcomes and lessons learned.
